knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_PRD_PROD_INF(prod_cd,prod_name,prod_descn,biz_modl_class_cD,prod_lvl_cd,father_prod_cd,on_off_bal_flag,sourc_sys)
SELECT prod_no, prod_name, '', '',
       TRIM(TO_CHAR(((LENGTH(A.prod_no)-1)/3+1),'9999999999')),
       CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.prod_no)>3 THEN SUBSTR(A.prod_no,1,LENGTH(A.prod_no)-3) ELSE '0' END,
       CASE SUBSTR(A.prod_no,1,1) WHEN '1' THEN '1' WHEN '2' THEN '0' ELSE '' END,
       'CRMS01'
  FROM FDM.F_PD_CRMS_LOAN_BIZ_PROD A
 WHERE START_DT <= '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND end_dt > '{ETL_TX_DT}'
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_PRD_PROD_INF(prod_cd,prod_name,prod_descn,biz_modl_class_cD,prod_lvl_cd,father_prod_cd,on_off_bal_flag,sourc_sys)
SELECT TYPENO AS prod_no, TYPENAME AS prod_name, '', '',
       TRIM(TO_CHAR(((LENGTH(TYPENO)-1)/3+1),'9999999999')),
       CASE WHEN LENGTH(TYPENO)>3 THEN SUBSTR(TYPENO,1,LENGTH(TYPENO)-3) ELSE '0' END,
       CASE SUBSTR(TYPENO,1,1) WHEN '1' THEN '1' WHEN '2' THEN '0' ELSE '' END,
       'CRMS01'
  FROM ODM.O_CRMS_BUSINESS_TYPE
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 共性层产品信息-接入信贷系统产品信息，来源系统CRMS01，通过产品编号编码规则自动推导产品层级、父产品和表内外标志
knowledgeBlocks.sqlFunction: 单表数据汇聚+编码规则推导
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 单表查询，通过信贷产品编号的编码规则（3位一层）自动计算产品层级、父产品关系和表内外标志
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 产品代码、产品名称、产品层级代码（自动计算）、父产品代码（自动计算）、表内外标志（按首字母推导）、来源系统

derivedKnowledge.knowledgeName: 信贷产品层级自动计算
derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT TYPENO, TRIM(TO_CHAR(((LENGTH(TYPENO)-1)/3+1),'9999999999')) AS prod_lvl FROM O_CRMS_BUSINESS_TYPE
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 信贷产品编号3位一层，根据编号长度自动计算产品层级，如3位为1层，6位为2层

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT TYPENO, CASE WHEN LENGTH(TYPENO)>3 THEN SUBSTR(TYPENO,1,LENGTH(TYPENO)-3) ELSE '0' END AS father_prod_cd FROM O_CRMS_BUSINESS_TYPE
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 通过去掉产品编号末3位得到父产品编号，3位以内默认为顶级'0'

derivedKnowledge.knowledgeName: 信贷产品表内外标志推导
derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT TYPENO, CASE SUBSTR(TYPENO,1,1) WHEN '1' THEN '1' WHEN '2' THEN '0' ELSE '' END AS on_off_bal_flag FROM O_CRMS_BUSINESS_TYPE
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 按产品编号首字母判断表内外标志：'1'开头=表内(1), '2'开头=表外(0)

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT TYPENO AS prod_no, TYPENAME AS prod_name FROM O_CRMS_BUSINESS_TYPE
